shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile relief on a pillar face
low-relief carving with outlined bodies against a plain ground
animal shown with head, legs and tail in strict side view
justification: Both surfaces show quadrupeds in strict profile carved in shallow relief on a flat pillar face, rendered schematically with simple outlined bodies and no interior detail, which is a fairly specific shared convention. However A shows a single isolated animal on an otherwise blank field, while B is a crowded multi-register composition combining a row of arcaded/pouch-like motifs, a banded frieze, several predators, a bird with outspread forms and other figures stacked vertically, so relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
